title: [Master]- Report 152 "Calculate Low Level Code" terminates with error: "Cannot add instance as another with key %1 has already been added." after upgrade to v28.1
summary: Report 152 now correctly handles items with multiple SKUs sharing the same Production BOM by replacing enumeration-based lookup with a direct dictionary key search in the BOM tree node logic.
key_points: Fixed a regression where Report 152 crashed when an item and its SKUs referenced the same Production BOM
Changed IsChild procedure from enumeration-based to O(1) key lookup to avoid leaving the shared enumerator in an incorrect state
Added regression test for items with multiple SKUs sharing one Production BOM
The issue occurred because exiting mid-enumeration left the shared enumerator stranded, preventing duplicate detection
quote: Replaced the enumeration in IsChild with a direct O(1) key lookup.
